causal-incidence.limitation: Incidence is supplied, not derived space. Jacobians cover one preparation, both couplings and physical memory tangents; no universal metric is inferred.
causal-incidence.question: Do event outputs depend only on their causal ancestors?
causal-incidence.reading: Green events descend from initial wave 0. Gray heatmap cells are nonancestors; their largest response is 0. Step-halving Jacobian difference is 4.24e-08.
causal-incidence.significance: Tests participant-only causal dependence and includes a disconnected branch as a null. Memory-response and intervention checks separately verify nontrivial dynamics.

matrix-balance.limitation: Displayed trajectory is the first gate of preparation 0. The Pauli component is basis dependent; the full Frobenius residual is the acceptance observable. This is not mechanical recoil.
matrix-balance.question: Does reciprocal memory exchange close the matrix-charge ledger?
matrix-balance.reading: Wave and memory charge components exchange with opposite signs. The smallest frozen-memory relative charge defect across all cases is 0.198.
matrix-balance.significance: Tests whether reciprocal memory dynamics closes the conserved matrix ledger; a prescribed frozen projector is an externally driven control.

numerical-audit.limitation: Finite circuit and finite states. U(2) covariance is not Lorentz covariance; numerical tolerance refinement is not a continuum limit. Exact zeros use a display floor.
numerical-audit.question: Do conservation and equivalent descriptions survive numerical refinement?
numerical-audit.reading: Largest event conservation residual 3.51e-10; exact-solution difference 2.45e-11; tolerance-halving difference 2.14e-11. Compare with 1e-9.
numerical-audit.significance: Checks integrated dynamics against a closed solution and tests description invariance under legal schedules and local frames.

order-controls.limitation: Generic noncommutativity is expected, not guaranteed for all states. These fixed controls do not define new candidate models or test propagation.
order-controls.question: Can the audit distinguish physical interventions from rescheduling?
order-controls.reading: Smallest shared-memory projector change 0.0673; smallest frozen-memory defect 0.198. Every preparation is compared with 1e-4.
order-controls.significance: Distinguishes changes to physical event ordering and reciprocal feedback from permissible rescheduling of independent events.
